title: Krouton disc set index (krouton-set-index.json), format version 1
description: Written at the root of every disc in a set Krouton spans across several discs, next to the BagIt files (bagit.txt, bag-info.txt, manifest-sha256.txt, tagmanifest-sha256.txt) or, for a disc with the files at its root, next to SHA256SUMS. Every disc carries the index of the whole set, so any one disc says which disc holds a given file. Keys are as written by Krouton's JSON encoder: sorted, with dates in ISO 8601.

setIdentifier.description: Identifies the set; the same on every disc of it. Also written as Bag-Group-Identifier in bag-info.txt.

title.description: The name the person gave the set.

volumeLabel.description: The ISO 9660 volume identifier burned on that disc; always ends in _Dnn when the set has more than one disc.

path.description: Path relative to data/ (or to the disc root for a SHA256SUMS disc), forward slashes, Unicode NFC.
